request: Compare how my income added up in the first half of 2025 against the second half.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) AS month_no, SUM(amount) AS got
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount > 0
  GROUP BY month_no
)
SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN month_no <= 6 THEN month_no ELSE month_no - 6 END AS TEXT) AS month_of_half,
       CASE WHEN month_no <= 6 THEN 'First half' ELSE 'Second half' END AS half,

FROM months
ORDER BY month_no

the half is the series, so one band per half and a legend

reasoning_code:
the shape is area and these rows carry a series, so one areaY and one lineY over all of them
the columns are month_of_half, half and cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
half names the series, so it is the z and the color channel on both marks and the legend goes on
